title: Digit Sum
problem: Given a non-negative integer N on a single line of input, print the sum of its digits. For example, for 4096 the answer is 4 + 0 + 9 + 6 = 19.
starter_code:
# Read a non-negative integer N.
# Print the sum of its digits.

# Write your code here

hints.1: Think about how to pull a number apart one digit at a time, and when to stop.
hints.2: In a while loop, n % 10 gives the last digit and n // 10 drops it. Add the last digit each time until n reaches 0. Reading the input as text and adding int() of each character works too.

failure_explanation: Use whole-number arithmetic: n % 10 is the last digit and n // 10 removes it (a single / gives a decimal number, so the digits come out wrong). Keep going until no digits are left, and check that a single-digit number and zero still give the right sum.
